dialogue.content: 本日は、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: お時間になりましたら、始めさせて頂きますね。
dialogue.English: We'll get started when it's time.

dialogue.content: はい、承知しました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.content: 相談員です。こんにちは、始めに年齢と性別を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: I'm the counselor. Hello. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 14歳。女子です
dialogue.English: I'm 14. A girl.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 友達に何度も裏切られました
dialogue.English: I’ve been betrayed by my friends many times.

dialogue.content: 生きたくないです
dialogue.English: I don't want to live anymore.

dialogue.content: 裏切られるのって、お辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: Being betrayed must be very painful.

dialogue.content: 生きたくないいんですね。
dialogue.English: You feel like you don’t want to live.

dialogue.content: 学校行くのも嫌だし、どうしたらいいかわかりません
dialogue.English: I hate going to school, and I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: うんうん、学校にも行きたくないほど悩んでるんですね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, you’re struggling so much that you don’t even want to go to school.

dialogue.content: はい、もう生きていたくないです
dialogue.English: Yes, I just don't want to live anymore.

dialogue.content: 生きたくないって思うのもくるしいですよね。もう少し、あなたの事教えてもらってもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Feeling like you don’t want to live is painful, too. Would it be alright if you told me a bit more about yourself?

dialogue.content: 学校へは登校されていらっしゃるのかな？
dialogue.English: Are you currently attending school?

dialogue.content: はい、行っています。
dialogue.English: Yes, I am.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。でも学校にいきたくないんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. But you don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: はい、本当に話せる友達もいません
dialogue.English: Yes, and I don’t have any friends I can really talk to.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お友達がいないのは、寂しいよね。いつもひとりなんですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It must be lonely not to have friends. Are you always by yourself?

dialogue.content: はい、入学してからというもの、気持ちを許せる友達もいなくて、
dialogue.English: Yes, ever since I started at this school, I haven’t had any friends I can open up to,

dialogue.content: 仕方なく同じクラスの班の子と話すくらいです
dialogue.English: I only talk to the kids in my class group because I have to.

dialogue.content: 余り、人といるのが苦手の様子にかんじるのですが、心を閉ざしちゃうのかな？
dialogue.English: It sounds like being with others might feel difficult for you. Do you find yourself closing yourself off, perhaps?

dialogue.content: 苦手っていうより・・・
dialogue.English: It's not that it's difficult, it's more that...

dialogue.content: ええ、聴いてますよ
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m listening.

dialogue.content: 小1の頃から嫌な思いをさせられて、人を信じられないような…思い出すと仲良くなれると思えなくて。
dialogue.English: I've had bad experiences since first grade, and it's made me unable to trust people... When I remember it, I just don't think I can become close friends with anyone.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。小さい頃に辛い思いをされてきたんですね
dialogue.English: I see. You went through some painful things when you were little.

dialogue.content: 人を信じられないような、お辛い経験って、お話できそうですか？
dialogue.English: Would you be willing to talk about those painful experiences that made it hard for you to trust people?

dialogue.content: 言いたくないことは、言わなくていいので、言える範囲で聞かせてね。
dialogue.English: You don't have to say anything you don't want to; please share only what you feel comfortable with.

dialogue.content: 仲良くしてた友達に呼び出されて、トイレに行ったんです。そしたら、突き飛ばされました。
dialogue.English: A friend I was close to called me to the bathroom, and when we got there, she pushed me.

dialogue.content: 集会の時は、見えないようにつねられたりもしました
dialogue.English: During assemblies, I would also get pinched where no one could see.

dialogue.content: それは、嫌な気持ちになりますよね。沢山、辛い思いをされてきたんですね。
dialogue.English: That must have felt awful. You've been through so many painful things.

dialogue.content: でもいい時は会って、楽しくしてたこともあったんですが、
dialogue.English: But there were good times when we'd meet up and have fun,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やっぱり、小学生の時は、いじわるされたり
dialogue.English: But still, in elementary school, they were mean to me,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 約束もすっぽかされて
dialogue.English: and they would stand me up, too,

dialogue.content: あらら
dialogue.English: Oh dear.

dialogue.content: 何事もなかったかのように知らん顔されたり
dialogue.English: and then they'd act like nothing ever happened.

dialogue.content: 辛いよね
dialogue.English: That's so painful.

dialogue.content: …本当に信じられないんです
dialogue.English: ...I really can't trust people.

dialogue.content: それだけ、色んな辛い事経験したら、誰でも、人を信じれなくなるよね
dialogue.English: After going through so many painful things, anyone would find it hard to trust others.

dialogue.content: それなのに、また誘ってくるから
dialogue.English: And yet, they keep inviting me out,

dialogue.content: 信じようと思っても裏切られます
dialogue.English: so even when I try to trust them, I just get betrayed again.

dialogue.content: 何度も、裏切られるのは悲しいよね。今まで、本当にお辛かったとおもいますし、今も繰り返して思い出しちゃうから、お友達とうまくつきあえないいんですね。
dialogue.English: Being betrayed over and over is heartbreaking. I imagine it’s been truly painful for you, and because those memories keep coming back, it’s hard for you to get along well with friends.

dialogue.content: それはあるかもしれません・・・
dialogue.English: That might be true...

dialogue.content: それは…。だとまだ他にどのような事がおありですか？
dialogue.English: I see. And are there other things happening as well?

dialogue.content: 去年は新しい友達作ろうと思ったけど、コロナのこともあって、結局何でも話せる友達はできませんでした
dialogue.English: Last year I tried to make new friends, but with COVID and everything, in the end I wasn't able to make any friends I could talk to about anything.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。お友達を作ろうというお気持ちがおありになるんですね。話せるお友達ができなかったのは、残念だですが…。
dialogue.English: I see. So you do have the desire to make friends. It’s a shame you weren’t able to make any friends you could talk to…

dialogue.content: 中2になって、その嫌な子と同じクラス同じ班になって、
dialogue.English: Now that I’m in my second year of middle school, I’m in the same class and the same group as that mean kid,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 仕方なく話すしかない感じです
dialogue.English: It feels like I have no choice but to talk to them.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。その子たちは、嫌な事とか、裏切ったりとかは？
dialogue.English: I see. Do those kids do hurtful things or betray you?

dialogue.content: あなたに対してですが
dialogue.English: Towards you, I mean.

dialogue.content: いつも裏切るのはその子だけなんですが、
dialogue.English: It's always just that one kid who betrays me, but…

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: その子だけなんですね。ごめんなさい。
dialogue.English: So it’s just that one person. I apologize.

dialogue.content: 小学校の時のこともあって面白くなかったので、その子に小学校の頃も嫌な気持ちを我慢してたことを伝えたんですけど、
dialogue.English: I wasn't happy about what happened in elementary school, so I told that person that I had been putting up with their hurtful behavior back then, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 悪口を言われるようになって
dialogue.English: they started bad-mouthing me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。いやだよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be horrible.

dialogue.content: 聞こえる様に言ってたこともあったりで
dialogue.English: Sometimes they would even say things loud enough for me to hear.

dialogue.content: つらいです
dialogue.English: It's painful.

dialogue.content: それは、耐えられないよね。そんな時は、あなたどうしてるんでしょう？？
dialogue.English: That's unbearable. What do you do in those situations?

dialogue.content: 同じ班の子と話すしかなくて
dialogue.English: I have no choice but to talk to the other kids in my group,

dialogue.content: 一緒に居ても心から笑えないし
dialogue.English: and even when I’m with them, I can’t genuinely smile,

dialogue.content: でも
dialogue.English: But…

dialogue.content: でも？同じ班の子とはお話ができるんですね。心から笑えないのも苦しいですね。
dialogue.English: But? So you are able to talk with the others in your group. It must be difficult not being able to genuinely smile.

dialogue.content: でも？何かな？
dialogue.English: But? What is it?

dialogue.content: 班行動では一緒だから、一緒に居るしかないし
dialogue.English: We're together for group activities, so I just have to be with them,

dialogue.content: ただ一緒にそこにいるだけみたいな感じです
dialogue.English: It feels like I'm just... there with them.

dialogue.content: そうですか、しょうがなく一緒にいる、なんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you're with them out of necessity.

dialogue.content: あなたはお話をお伺いしてますと、去年もお友達作る前向きさもあるように思えますがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: From what you've told me, it sounds like you had a positive attitude about making friends last year. Is that how you see it?

dialogue.content: その時はそう思ってましたが、今はグループが既にできてしまっています
dialogue.English: I felt that way then, but now, groups have already formed.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。過去のお辛い経験から、どうしても誰といても不安にかんじてしまうんでしょうね。
dialogue.English: I see. Because of your painful past experiences, you probably can't help but feel anxious no matter who you're with.

dialogue.content: グループに入らないと、お友達は作れないんですか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel like you have to be in a group to make friends?

dialogue.content: グループ…
dialogue.English: A group...

dialogue.content: 私が勝手に思う事で、ごめんなさいね。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, that's just my own assumption.

dialogue.content: グループの輪のような…。感じです。
dialogue.English: Like a social circle... that's the feeling I get.

dialogue.content: そもそも悪く言われていて・・・そこにはいても、笑えない自分がいます
dialogue.English: To begin with, people are bad-mouthing me... so even when I'm there, I find I can't genuinely smile.

dialogue.content: それは、本当にお辛いですね。今日ここへいらっしゃいましたのも、何か少しでも笑える自分になりたいのかな？という希望がおありだとかんじましたが、どうでしょう？
dialogue.English: That is truly very painful. I sensed that part of the reason you came here today might be a hope to become someone who can smile, even just a little. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.content: 自分が笑えるようになるっていう想像がつきません
dialogue.English: I can't imagine myself ever being able to smile.

dialogue.content: なんで悪口言われるのか、わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't understand why they say bad things about me.

dialogue.content: 私が悪いんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it my fault?

dialogue.content: 想像がつかないのもわかりますよ。ゆっくりでいいと思うので、なぜ、悪口を言われるのかこれから考えていきましょうね。あなたは前向きに生きてますよ。
dialogue.English: I can understand why you can't imagine it. We can take our time and think together about why they say bad things about you. You are trying to live positively.

dialogue.content: もっと自信を持たれてくださいね
dialogue.English: Please try to have more confidence in yourself.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: まだまだ、お話を聴きたいんですが、お時間がきてしまいましたので、またいつでも、ここへ来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: I would love to hear more, but our time is up for today. Please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えていきましょうね。
dialogue.English: Let’s continue to think this through together.

dialogue.content: それでは終了します。
dialogue.English: We’ll end here for today.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.
